こちらの作品を投稿しました!

今回のボイスはタイトルの通り
【あなたのわがままを全部聞いてくれるお姉さんと生ハメえっちASMRボイス】です!

あなたが胸の内に秘めたあんなことやこんなことをしたい!という劣情をえっちなお姉さんが全部叶えてくれるボイスとなっております。

このボイスでいっぱい想像して欲しいな。
ボイスにない事も想像の中でちゃんと叶えてあげる。

みんなが満足できるかはわからないけれど、
頑張って撮影したからよかったら聞いてほしいな!
無料でサンプルボイスも聞けるから試してみてね!

少しでもみんなの癒しになると嬉しいな!

Hello, good evening.
It is nice to meet you.
My name is Tsunami Uminari.
I stream ASMR voices on Twitch and youtube.
These voices are the ones you can listen to on Fantia and Ci-en with a paid plan,
I have decided to sell the voices to those who are not interested in supporting the paid plan but are still interested in the voices.
I've posted this piece here!

I hope you'll come check out Twitch, Youtube, Fantia and Ci-en if you'd like!
I'll also put up a Discord Fan Server, Donations, and Amazon Wish List.
Please support and browse if you like!

This time the voice is as the title says.
I want to do such and such a thing that you have in your heart!

I want to do such and such a thing that you have in your heart! This is a voice that will fulfill all of your selfish desires.

I want you to imagine a lot with this voice.
I'll make what's not in the voice come true in your imagination.

I don't know if everyone will be satisfied,
I don't know if you'll be satisfied with it, but I did my best to film it, so please listen to it if you like!
You can listen to a sample voice for free, so give it a try!

I'd be happy if I can be a little bit of a comfort to everyone!
